scientific_integrity: Exact 144-branch rational enumeration accompanied by noncomputational infeasibility and line-integration lemmas; explicit attained witness. Finite random checks are supplementary and do not establish universal truth. All cited public dates refer to actual publicly accessible lead literature.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted open four-vertex path, nonnegative real inputs, centered graph balls with unit vertex mass, adjacent first-difference total variation. Not extended to signed inputs, larger paths, or weighted graphs. Novelty is based on accessible comparisons and remains subject to unindexed priority.
title: Sharp two-input variation sensitivity of centered maximal averaging on a four-vertex path
